Build:
param([string]$SubmissionPath)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'F:\.codex\worktrees\ecs-relations-worker-3\SomeEngine.Next'
$source='__SOURCE__'
$control='artifacts/relations-measurements/final-packages-__ROUND__'
$packageArea=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('artifacts/ecs-relations')
$packageFeed=Join-Path $packageArea 'feed'
$packageCache=Join-Path $packageArea 'cache'
$consumerDirectory=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('tools/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.AotSmoke')
$consumerProject=Join-Path $consumerDirectory 'SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.AotSmoke.csproj'
$nativeOutput=Join-Path $consumerDirectory 'bin/Release/net10.0/win-x64/native-publish'
$stagePath=Join-Path $packageArea "package-stages-$source.json"
$packStagePath=Join-Path $packageArea "package-pack-stages-$source.json"
$sourceArgument="-p:SourceRevisionId=$source"
$packageNames=@('SomeEngine.Diagnostics','SomeEngine.Job.Contracts','SomeEngine.Job','SomeEngine.ECS.SourceGen','SomeEngine.ECS','SomeEngine.ECS.Relations','SomeEngine.ECS.Systems','SomeEngine.Physics')
[xml]$consumerXml=Get-Content -LiteralPath $consumerProject -Raw
$packageVersion=[string]$consumerXml.Project.PropertyGroup.SomeEnginePackageVersion
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $control,$packageFeed,$packageCache -Force|Out-Null
while(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $SubmissionPath)){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}
$queue=Get-Content -LiteralPath $SubmissionPath -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$stages=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Run-Stage([string]$Stage,[string]$StageExecutable,[string[]]$StageArguments){
 $name=$Stage.Replace(':','-')
 $stdout=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath("$control/$name.stdout.log")
 $stderr=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath("$control/$name.stderr.log")
 $started=[DateTime]::UtcNow
 & $StageExecutable @StageArguments 1> $stdout 2> $stderr
 $code=$LASTEXITCODE
 $record=[pscustomobject]@{Stage=$Stage;SourceCommit=$source;QueueId=$queue.Id;Executable=$StageExecutable;Arguments=$StageArguments;StartedAtUtc=$started;FinishedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow;ExitCode=$code;Stdout=$stdout;Stderr=$stderr}
 $stages.Add($record)
 $stages|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content -LiteralPath $stagePath -Encoding utf8
 Write-Output ('PACKAGE_STAGE '+($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7 -Compress))
 Get-Content -LiteralPath $stdout -Tail 12|Write-Output
 if($code -ne 0){Get-Content -LiteralPath $stderr -Tail 20|Write-Output;exit $code}
}

try{
 $series='focused-native-__ROUND__'
 $reports="artifacts/ecs-relations/measurements/$series"
 $sourceRecord=Get-Content -LiteralPath "artifacts/relations-measurements/$series/source.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 $final=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/__FINAL_QUEUE__/result.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 $approved=Get-Content -LiteralPath "docs/evidence/ECS-Relations-2026-10-19/$series/approved-summary.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
 $postStages=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath "$reports/postprocess-stages.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)
 $submissions=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath "$reports/submissions.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)
 $cases=@(foreach($item in $submissions){
  $result=Get-Content -LiteralPath "artifacts/benchmark-queue/$($item.QueueId)/result.json" -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  $report=Get-Content -LiteralPath $item.Report -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
  [pscustomobject]@{CaseId=$item.CaseId;QueueId=$item.QueueId;ExitCode=$result.ExitCode;SourceCommit=$report.Device.SourceCommit;Equal=$report.Equivalence.Equal}
 })
 $continue=$final.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $sourceRecord.SourceCommit -eq $source -and $sourceRecord.PublishExitCode -eq 0 -and $sourceRecord.SourceCheckExitCode -eq 0 -and $cases.Count -eq 2 -and @($cases|Where-Object{$_.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $_.SourceCommit -ne $source -or !$_.Equal}).Count -eq 0 -and $approved.Summary.Equal -eq 2 -and $approved.Summary.Required -eq 2 -and $approved.Summary.ApprovedPassed -eq 2 -and $postStages.Count -eq 3 -and @($postStages|Where-Object ExitCode -ne 0).Count -eq 0
 $gate=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;ReportQueueId=$final.Id;ApprovedRatioLimit=1.01;FocusedEqual=$approved.Summary.Equal;FocusedApproved=$approved.Summary.ApprovedPassed;Cases=$cases;Continue=$continue;FinalAcceptancePending=$true;RecordedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow}
 $gate|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath "$control/preparation.json" -Encoding utf8
 Write-Output ('PACKAGE_GATE '+($gate|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress))
 if(!$continue){exit 2}
 git diff --exit-code $source -- '*.cs'
 if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
 Run-Stage 'BuildPackages' 'dotnet' @('build','src/SomeEngine.Physics/SomeEngine.Physics.csproj','-c','Release','--no-restore','-p:EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles=true',$sourceArgument)
 foreach($name in $packageNames){
  Run-Stage "Pack:$name" 'dotnet' @('pack',"src/$name/$name.csproj",'-c','Release','--no-build',"-p:Version=$packageVersion",$sourceArgument,'-o',$packageFeed)
 }
 @($stages|Where-Object Stage -like 'Pack:*')|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7|Set-Content -LiteralPath $packStagePath -Encoding utf8
}finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath}
